notes: New: ask your own AI about any page. Click the purple question mark, mark an area or up to five pages, pick one of eleven prepared questions or write your own, and set how it answers with four dials (with a recommendation for each course). On Windows the images open in a folder and the question is copied, ready for the AI you already use, such as Gemini or ChatGPT. No API key. Check now asks once who grades, the app's AI or your own AI app; hold Check to choose again. Curriculum workbooks take no frames of your own any more.
